dossier.summary: Bellhaven Physio runs four physiotherapy clinics in and around Leeds, with same-week appointments and direct billing to the main private insurers. The site offers online booking.
dossier.why_now: Opened a fourth clinic in Headingley in September.

data.summary: Your homepage leads with a welcome and a line about moving better. The sketch leads with same-week appointments at four clinics around Leeds, which the page says further down.

today.headline: Welcome to Bellhaven Physio
today.sub: We are dedicated to helping you move better, feel better and live better through expert, personalised physiotherapy care.
today.section_body: Our highly qualified physiotherapists treat a wide range of conditions, from sports injuries and back pain to post-surgical rehabilitation. Whatever your goal, we will create a personalised treatment plan to get you there.

sketch.headline: Physio in Leeds this week, at four clinics, billed to your insurer
sketch.sub: Same-week appointments at Bellhaven's four clinics around Leeds, with direct billing to the main private insurers.
sketch.proof: Four clinics, including the new one in Headingley
sketch.image: A physiotherapist with a patient in the Headingley treatment room
sketch.section_heading: What we treat, and how soon you are seen
sketch.section_intro: Three things Bellhaven treats, and what the first visit looks like for each.

points.title: Sports injuries
points.text: Assessed at the first visit, with a plan that gets you back to training in steps.

points.title: Back pain
points.text: Treatment in the clinic and exercises to keep up at home, in one personalised plan.

points.title: After surgery
points.text: Rehabilitation in steps, from the first weeks after the operation to full movement.

notes.note: Leads with the three things a patient in pain checks first: where, how soon and who pays. Welcome to Bellhaven Physio tells them none of those.
Keeps to the facts the page already states lower down, so the reader does not have to scroll to find the four clinics.
The new Headingley clinic is news for anyone nearby, and it backs the four clinics line with a name.
Adds how soon to the what, because the wait is the question a patient asks before the condition.
The three conditions you list get a line each on what the first visit looks like, so a reader can see themselves in one of them.
